scope: Linux x86_64; exact final native LSL frontend/backend pair; no C QBE used.
Runs overlapped other correctness tests; their durations are not performance benchmarks.
HTTP baseline and native compilers use the same patched checkout stdlib, with original baseline executable bytes preserved.

HTTP message arguments are represented by their named verifier case to avoid repeating long messages.
This report does not claim complete original integration corpus success; that is verified separately by the coordinator.
